paragraphs.text: The Voda Sea is the name of a sea in the Domains of Dominaria , connected to the Vodalian merfolk empire.

The Voda Sea was originally located near Sarpadia , but when Galina led her people away from there and settled in their new location of Etlan Shiis , they brought the name of the sea with them. The original sea was then renamed Old Voda Sea .

The new Voda Sea lies east of Aerona and Shanodin and west of the Burning Isles . As such, it is the crossroads for the greatest civilizations of Dominaria. The northern extent of the Voda Sea is Stahaan . In the south it reaches to Ru-Nora and Sardnia , before changing into the Kukemssa Sea .

Before the Founding of New Vodalia , the sea was home to the merfolk of Etlan Shiis , who lived for thousands of years under the rule of a council. When Galina and her retinue appeared in the sea after the Tolarian Temporal Disaster , they quickly assumed control of the city, murdering the councilors and placing Galina as empress of the new realm. (archived) New Vodalia would continue to expand for over a millennium under her rule, and the seas around Etlan Shiis was thus renamed Voda Sea.
